image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a Nile crocodile resting on a concrete or stone bank next to water. The view focuses primarily on the dorsal surface of the tail and hindquarters, extending towards the mid-body. The head is partially visible in the upper right but cut off by the frame edge. The skin texture shows distinct, rough osteoderms (scutes) in longitudinal rows. The tail tapers towards the bottom left, showing signs of wear or injury at the tip. A small bird is perched near the crocodile's flank.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is largely outside the frame or obscured by the angle; only the posterior neck/shoulder region is clearly visible. Cannot verify snout shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The jawline and teeth are not visible in this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are not visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body and tail clearly shows heavy armor plating and an elongated structure consistent with a crocodilian.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct longitudinal rows of raised, bony scutes are clearly visible running down the spine and tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of muddy yellow, brown, and grey/black on the ridges, with a very rough, realistic texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) side is against the ground and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only a small portion of the right hind limb is visible at the top edge; digits and webbing cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is clearly visible, showing lateral compression (height > width) and muscular structure tapering correctly.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The tip of the tail appears slightly 'melted' or smudged into the background rock/water interface. The scute pattern dissolves rather than ending in a clean anatomical point, suggesting a minor generation artifact or inpainting error.
The connection between the visible hind leg and the body is somewhat indistinct. The scales seem to blend into the limb without a clear joint definition, though this could be due to lighting/angle.
The small bird perched on the crocodile's back lacks clear definition. It appears as a blurry, dark blob without distinct feathers or anatomy, typical of AI struggling with small secondary subjects.
